composites.name: diffusion-reaction-with-viz
composites.description: Smoldyn diffusion-reaction demo with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running molecule-count trajectories, written to the 'viz_html' store.

interval.description: Process interval in simulation time units.

rate_ab.description: First-order reaction rate constant for A -> B.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.

composites.name: reversible-dimerization
composites.description: Smoldyn 3D reversible dimerization: fast red monomers A diffuse and bind pairwise into slower blue dimers B (A + A <-> B) in a reflecting cubic box. Emits per-species counts, per-molecule positions, and time each step — the positions drive a Simularium trajectory.

composites.name: enzyme-kinetics
composites.description: Smoldyn 3D Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics: enzyme E (purple) binds substrate S (orange) into complex ES (red), which turns over to product P (blue) and frees E (E + S <-> ES -> E + P). Emits per-molecule positions for a Simularium trajectory.

composites.name: three-species-crowding
composites.description: Smoldyn 3D differential diffusion: three species (fast red A, medium green B, slow blue C) diffuse from the same start in a reflecting cubic box, demixing by mobility. No reactions — a clean view of Brownian spread rates. Emits per-molecule positions for a Simularium trajectory.

composites.name: diffusion-reaction-demo
composites.description: Tiny Smoldyn diffusion-reaction demo: species A (fast) diffuses and converts to species B (slow) via a first-order reaction in a 2D reflecting box. Emits per-species molecule counts and simulation time each step.

interval.description: Process interval in simulation time units. Each update advances Smoldyn via runUntil() by this amount.

rate_ab.description: First-order reaction rate constant for A -> B.
